missing-evidence-id.note: Claim cites src-404, which was never captured.

claim-without-evidence.note: Claim cites nothing; schema and evidence policy both object.

fabricated-quote.note: Real source, plausible quote, the source never says it.

short-quote.note: A two-word quote cannot ground a claim.

empty-evidence.note: Cited record captured with empty content.

content-tampered.note: Content edited after capture; hash no longer matches.

content-not-captured.note: Only references were captured, so quotes cannot be checked.

schema-invalid.note: Output carries a field the contract does not allow.

numeric-mismatch.note: Narrative number differs from the captured value.

numeric-value-missing.note: Numeric claim cites a record with no structured value.

stale-source.note: Source is two years old; freshness is advisory, so it is shown but allowed.

disallowed-source.note: Evidence from a source outside the allowlist.

unsafe-locator.note: A javascript: locator would be an XSS vector in any report.

unauthorized-tool.note: Worker tried publish.post; the guard blocked it before invocation.

foreign-tool-caller.note: A tool call under this contract came from another agent.

deadline-extended.note: Deadline edited after issue; instance digest breaks.

acceptance-by-other.note: Accepted by an identity that is not the worker.

policy-changed.note: Contract issued under different obligations than the current policy.

no-claims.note: Output declares no claims; nothing would be verified.

contract-at-final-answer.note: A contract relabelled as a final answer to skip its checks.

tool-before-acceptance.note: Observe mode let a tool run before acceptance; the event still fails.

secret-in-claim.note: Valid run whose claim text contains a secret; receipts must not leak it.
